nodes.label: --update Incremental Re-extraction
nodes.rationale: Only re-extracts new/changed files (detected via detect_incremental) to save tokens and time versus a full rebuild.

nodes.label: build_merge Replace-on-Re-extract
nodes.rationale: (#1344) Every source_file present in new_chunks is dropped from the base graph before merge, so changed files never leave stale nodes behind; prune_sources is reserved only for genuinely deleted files, not changed ones (would otherwise wrongly delete re-extracted content per #1178).

nodes.label: --cluster-only Mode
nodes.rationale: Self-contained re-cluster of the existing graph; must not re-run Steps 5-9 since a prior build's cleanup already deleted the intermediate files they depend on (#1392).

nodes.label: Manifest Semantic-Hash Staleness Guard
nodes.rationale: (#2015/#1948) Only files that actually produced output this run are stamped in the manifest; dispatched-but-unstamped files (failed chunks) have their semantic_hash cleared so the next --update re-queues them instead of treating lost content as done.
